lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Reichenbach FallNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 26TWO ENGLISHMEN AT THE FALLS: ONE SURVIVORWatson was beside you on the path, and he was the one who saw it. He tells the guides, in a flat voice, that the Professor came along the ledge, that there was a struggle, that the two men fell together. He does not say what you said before. He puts your note in his pocket-book, and carries it for the rest of his life, and when he is asked, years afterwards, whether he has ever lost a friend, he answers only that he has lost the best and the wisest man whom he has ever known. He is remembered as a man who knew how to work with others: a Doctor, a Brother, an Inspector, a Boy.
